cards.back: The output of an LTI system to a unit impulse; it determines all input-output behavior through convolution.
A value of the transform variable where a system transfer function's denominator is zero.
The frequency range over which performance meets a stated gain, phase, or error criterion.
The phase delay of a system output relative to a sinusoidal input at a given frequency.
The input-output relationship after feedback is connected; for negative unity feedback it is G/(1+G).
The ability to maintain acceptable stability and performance despite uncertainty and unmodeled effects.
Excessive accumulation of the integral controller state while an actuator is saturated.
A digital implementation that samples a signal and holds the value between updates.
